title: Zephyr: source class enumeration
description: Time source class enumeration. AC: Enum with GNSS, Network, Local, Manual, RTC, Monotonic values.
notes: Followed the bead/parent epic's authoritative time-source scope (GNSS, Network, Local-client, Manual/static, Internal RTC, Monotonic); the dispatch phrase about IPv6 direct/local/global/off-mesh classification belongs a different address-classification feature. Existing enum/wire strings matched spec and Rust. Fixed malformed C enum values fail-closed in lichen_time_source_can_establish_wall_clock instead of treating every non-Monotonic integer as authoritative. Added isolated shared canonical string/order/capability tests. Preserved the unrelated existing time_sync_update_from_parent hunk and link.h dirt. Gates: standalone strict C+UBSan 1/1; Zephyr qemu_cortex_m3 build/run 2/2 (FLASH 21123 B, RAM 5440 B); Clang static analyzer clean; Rust lichen-link time_source tests 2/2; diff check clean. Python parity collection is temporarily blocked by unrelated dirty timing/provisioning.py circular import (TimeAdmin from partially initialized time_sync); no Python files were touched, while C's canonical table directly matches the Python SourceClass values and Rust tests. Checkpatch had no errors; remaining warnings/checks are repository SPDX/stdint conventions and pre-existing time_sync style.
